thread:
raj (customer): Hey team — getting 403s from the /v1/generate endpoint after a token rotation. Happening for only one org header value, other projects work. Error body: "unauthorized: audience claim mismatch". req-id: req-4f7a9c

emily (support): Sorry you're hitting this, thanks for reporting. Can you paste the curl you used and the full response headers (especially x-request-id)? also which org header/value you sent?

raj (customer): here's the minimal repro I used:

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOi..." \ 
  -H "X-Redwood-Org: org_abc123" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"hello"}'
```

Response (truncated):
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 15:12:02 GMT
X-Request-Id: req-4f7a9c
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"unauthorized: audience claim mismatch - token aud:project:xyz vs header org:org_abc123"}

emily (support): perfect, that's the sort of detail we need. two quick asks: 1) can you run with -v and paste HTTP response headers (we want any x-auth-*, x-proj-*, and x-request-* headers), 2) can you grab the token's decoded payload (base64 decode the middle part) and paste the aud/iss/sub claims (redact full token)

raj (customer): pasted decoded aud: "aud":"project:xyz" and iss: "https://id.redwood.example/". so token aud is project:xyz but I was calling with X-Redwood-Org: org_abc123. I thought org header would work cross-project.

support-bot: New support ticket created: TCK-9812. Assigned to emily. Collected req-id req-4f7a9c. :white_check_mark:

ingrid (sre): this looks like the auth microservice enforcing aud==org mapping. raj can you confirm whether the token is a service key vs org-scoped key? service keys often have aud=project:..., org keys aud=org:...

raj (customer): it's a service key issued to our CI, we use it for project-level workflows. The app used to accept it with X-Redwood-Org header until a few days ago after rotation.

sam (eng): quick triage notes: recent change in auth proxy tightened aud verification when X-Redwood-Org is present to prevent cross-org access. Likely regression or config drift. We'll need the debug bundle to correlate proxy logs with req-id.

emily (support): can you collect the debug bundle by doing these steps and attach a tarball here?

1) Reproduce the call with -v and capture req-id header. e.g. `curl -i -v ...`
2) Grab the response headers and full error body
3) From the token (not the key), paste decoded claims: aud, sub, exp (redact other fields)
4) Note exact timestamps in UTC when you ran it
5) If possible, run `openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.example:443 -servername api.redwood.example -showcerts` and paste the first cert subject commonName only (helps rule out SNI proxies)

raj (customer): attaching outputs in a zip in the ticket — filename debug-raj-20260317.zip. includes curl -v logs, decoded claims, and the response headers + timestamps.

emily (support): got it, thanks. ingrid/sam — I uploaded the debug bundle to the incident bucket (TCK-9812). req-id req-4f7a9c maps to proxy node proxy-12 at 2026-03-17T15:12:02Z.

ingrid (sre): pulled logs; proxy-12 shows 403 with rule audit.aud_mismatch triggered. Payload shows token aud=project:xyz and incoming X-Redwood-Org org_abc123. There's an allowlist check that used to accept service-key-with-org header but the policy was tightened in last config roll (config id cfg-2026-03-14-9).

sam (eng): plan: 1) short-term rollback of the strict check for service keys (we can flip rollback flag) to restore previous behavior. 2) longer-term: update docs and add clearer error message including suggestion: use X-Redwood-Project header for project-scoped tokens or issue an org-scoped token.

raj (customer): thanks — what's the temporary workaround? we can't rotate all CI keys immediately.

emily (support): temporary options:
- call with X-Redwood-Project: project:xyz instead of X-Redwood-Org, or
- request an org-scoped token from your admin (aud=org:org_abc123), or
- we can flip the rollback flag for your org while you rotate keys (tell us the org id and a time window)

raj (customer): we'll switch to X-Redwood-Project for now and follow up if we need the rollback. switching headers fixed it locally. thanks. :pray:

emily (support): great — marking TCK-9812 as actionable. sam/ingrid will follow up for permanent fix. closing this thread once the rollback/doc tasks are scheduled. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: TCK-9812 status updated to triaged.
